preconditions.description: The number of elements in permutation p is between 1 and 10^6, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: All p_i are distinct integers between 1 and n, inclusive.
preconditions.description: The elements of permutation p are distinct integers from 1 to n.

postconditions.expression: Output is '-1' if no permutation q exists such that q^2 = p.
postconditions.description: The output is '-1' if there is no permutation q that, when squared, equals the input permutation p.

postconditions.expression: Output is a permutation q of length n if such q exists.
postconditions.description: The output is a permutation q of length n that, when squared, equals the input permutation p.
